facts.material: housing (plastic or metal) containing multiple filter media layers
facts.function: filters and purifies water flowing to the shower head
facts.form: complete inline filter unit fitted between shower arm and shower head

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8421 covers filtering or purifying machinery and apparatus for liquids; the shower filter is a complete filtering apparatus, not a shower head or plumbing fitting
Section XVI applies; the article is not a part of a shower head but a stand-alone filter
GRI 6: 8421.21 for filtering or purifying water, 8421.21.00.00

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of filtering apparatus; the product is a complete filter unit, not a replacement cartridge alone
shower heads classified by material; the article filters water and is not a shower head
taps, valves and similar appliances; the article does not control flow, it filters

classification.rationale: An inline shower filter with several filtration layers is apparatus for filtering or purifying water within heading 8421 under GRI 1. It is a complete filter, not a shower head or valve, so subheading 8421.21 (for filtering or purifying water) applies, statistical line 8421.21.00.00. CBP consistently classifies household water filters in 8421.21.0000, for example NY N347101 (in force).
